name: InvoiceXpress API
description: An API integration for InvoiceXpress (Portuguese invoicing/billing service).
project_description:
The InvoiceXpress API module integrates the certified invoicing system Invoicexpress directly with your Drupal website. Automate the generation, management, and delivery of invoices, saving time and ensuring compliance with legal invoicing requirements.

 Streamline your Drupal site's invoicing process with the InvoiceXpress API integration. Save time, ensure compliance, and focus on growing your business.

 
 
 Back to top 

 Key Features 
 
 Automatic Invoice Generation 
 
 Generate invoices automatically from orders, registrations, or specific actions within Drupal. 
 
 
 Simplified Invoice Management 
 
 Access, view, or edit invoices directly from the Drupal administration panel. 
 
 
 Real-Time Data Synchronization 
 
 All invoices are seamlessly synced with your InvoiceXpress account in real time. 
 
 
 E-commerce Compatibility 
 
 Integrates effortlessly with Drupal Commerce, enabling automatic invoicing for customer purchases. 
 
 
 Certified and Secure API 
 
 Utilizes the official InvoiceXpress API, ensuring security and compliance with local regulations. 
 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Services 
 Invoicexpress API has 4 services available:

 
 invoicexpress_api.invoices 
 invoicexpress_api.estimates 
 invoicexpress_api.clients 
 invoicexpress_api.sequences 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Follow these steps to install and configure the InvoiceXpress API module:

 
 Install the Module 
 
 Use Composer to install the module: composer require drupal/invoicexpress_api 
 
 
 API Credentials 
 
 Obtain your InvoiceXpress API credentials (API key and account details) from your InvoiceXpress dashboard. 
 Important: This module requires a direct contract with InvoiceXpress to access their invoicing services. For more details, visit: InvoiceXpress – Drupal Integration Module . 
 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Go to the configuration page: /admin/config/services/invoicexpress_api 
 Enter your API credentials and adjust settings as needed.
